description: Cleaned Arabic-to-English lexical lookup dictionary extracted from unified_ar_en.csv and unified_en_ar.csv, curated specifically for word-level lookup in Madeit.
cleaningsApplied: Windows-1256 and Latin1 to UTF-8 mojibake decoding and recovery
Control characters and binary length prefix stripping
Removal of non-Arabic / non-English languages (Persian, Turkish, Polish, Spanish)

Removal of HTML tags (

, ,
) and email addresses
Removal of pharmaceutical and chemical formula entries
Arabic text normalization (tashkeel stripping, alef/hamza unification, ta-marbuta/ha normalization)
Deduplication and frequency-based ranking of English translations
Constraint enforcement: maximum 3 concise English meanings per Arabic word
